item.title: Schools
item.description:
I interpreted “all schools” as TDSB public schools that serve JK, consistent with your earlier request. These are ranked by the latest Fraser score above 8.0; commute is a current transit estimate from the school site to 700 University Ave. I counted 60 minutes as within one hour.

These three also qualify by score and commute, but are alternative schools—admission is not based on living in a normal catchment, so they are not apartment-search targets:

The scores are from the current Fraser 2025 elementary report, based on 2023–24 results. I excluded Iroquois JPS because its transit time was about 80 minutes. Treat all “~60 min” rows as borderline: a specific apartment at the edge of a catchment can exceed an hour. TDSB maps are approximate; use the linked street guide to confirm every address.
